title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You
native: 君のことが大大大大大好きな100人の彼女
synopsis:
Rentarou Aijou was rejected 100 times in middle school. He visits a shrine and prays for better luck in high school. The God of Love appears and promises that he’ll soon meet 100 people he’s destined to date. But there’s a catch—once destiny introduces someone to him, the two must happily love each other. If they don’t, they’ll die. What will befall Rentarou and his 100 girlfriends in high school?

(Source: Crunchyroll)
alt_seasons: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You Season 2 (2025)

episodes.title: The 2 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really Love You (98 To Go)
episodes.synopsis: Aijo Rentaro has faced 100 rejections in life, and when he goes to a matchmaking shrine to pray for love, he finds that he will get more than he ever bargained for in high school. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: First Kiss
episodes.synopsis: Hakari and Karane learn that Rentaro hasn't had his first kiss yet. They may both be his girlfriends, but they still want his first kiss for themselves! (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Quiet Princess, The Knight, and The Samurai
episodes.synopsis: Rentaro has encountered his third soulmate: the shy and smol Yoshimoto Shizuka. How will he get her to open up to him and, more importantly, how will he choose to deal with her? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Just When You Think It's a Hanky-Panky Episode
episodes.synopsis: Rentaro has a plan to break the ice between Hakari, Karane, and Shizuka, and it involves laughter and Old Maid. But things take a turn for the unexpected. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Hyper-Efficient Girl
episodes.synopsis: Rentaro encounters the smartest student in school, Eiai Nano, and it turns out she's a soulmate, too! However, her extreme rationality leads him to question whether they really are meant for each other. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Everyone's Favorite: The Swimsuit Episode
episodes.synopsis: Rentaro and the girls hit the newly opened water park at Hakari's suggestion, but Karane appears to have come down with a mysterious chill. Will the gang really get to enjoy their day out at the pool? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Saying Hello to the Chemistry Girl
episodes.synopsis: Rentaro locks eyes with another soulmate: a beautiful girl in the Chemistry Lab. But when he visits the lab the next day, he instead finds a pint-sized bundle of energy who is... obsessed with drugs? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Kiss Zombie Panic
episodes.synopsis: Under attack from the kiss zombies, can Rentaro and Kusuri figure out a way to turn them back to normal? Or are they doomed to smooch forever? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Holy War of Love and Soul
episodes.synopsis: The gang has a day out at a flower park on Hakari's suggestion. Little did they know that she did it for a reason. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Love Mission: Impossible
episodes.synopsis: The Rentaro Family gears up to raid the Hanazono mansion to get Hakari out. (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Even If It Kills Me
episodes.synopsis: Hahari may have been blinded by love, but Hakari's happiness remains her number one priority. How can Rentaro convince her that his love is real? (Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You (94 To Go)
episodes.synopsis: How will the gang adjust to the newest girlfriend, and what shenanigans will she bring into play during this sleepover? (Source: Crunchyroll)
